idea-plugin.name: DrakoFlow Diagram Engine
idea-plugin.description:
DrakoFlow: Privacy-First Text-to-Diagram Engine for JetBrains IDEs

DrakoFlow is a lightweight, offline-first, client-side text-to-diagram engine that turns human-readable declarative DSL code (.drako) into interactive, themeable architecture diagrams, sequence flows, and Git branching workflows.

Edit your diagram scripts on the left and see the rendered diagram update live in real-time on the right with bi-directional highlighting, interactive zoom/pan, and zero server dependencies.

✨ Key Highlights

  • Live Split-View Preview: Instant, lag-free diagram rendering synchronized with your editor as you type.
  • Bi-Directional Code ↔ Canvas Highlighting: Hover over diagram components to highlight the corresponding lines in your editor, and move your cursor in the editor to highlight nodes in the diagram.
  • Specialized Git Flow Engine: Dedicated @layout: git-flow engine visualizing branch swimlanes, smooth Bézier merge curves, commit hash badges, and release tags.
  • Sequence & Architecture Flowcharts: Horizontal and vertical layouts with lifelines, animated flow arrows, and auto-routing.
  • Extensive UML & Component Library: Model systems with Cube (3D isometric), Cylinder (database), Package, Actor, Process, Diamond, Class, Cloud, Storage, Queue, and more.
  • 20+ Built-in Tech Icons: Add Docker, AWS, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Redis, Python, React, Node, and more directly to components.
  • 100% Offline & Private: All rendering runs locally via embedded Chromium/JCEF. No diagram data is ever transmitted to external servers.
  • PlantUML Importer: Translate existing PlantUML diagrams directly into DrakoFlow DSL.

🚀 Quick Start

  1. Create or open any file with the .drako extension.
  2. Use IntelliJ's native top-right split editor controls to switch between Editor Only, Split View, or Preview Only.
  3. Write your diagram DSL and watch it render live!

📝 Example DSL

// Architecture & Sequence Flow
Client: Process {
  label: "Client App"
  lifeline: true
  icon: "react"
}

Server: Process {
  label: "API Server"
  lifeline: true
  icon: "docker"
}

Database: Cylinder {
  label: "PostgreSQL Database"
  icon: "postgres"
}

Client -> Server: "1. GET /users" { lineStyle: "solid" }
Server -> Database: "2. Query Database" { lineStyle: "dashed" }
Database -> Server: "3. User Records" { lineStyle: "dashed" }
Server -> Client: "4. 200 OK (JSON)" { color: "#34d399" }

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of DrakoFlow Diagram Engine for IntelliJ IDEA and JetBrains IDEs.
  • Real-time split editor preview for .drako files.
  • Bi-directional code and diagram component highlighting.
  • Support for Sequence, Architecture, Flowcharts, and Git Flow layouts.
  • Full offline rendering support.
